title: Skill YAML
description: Per-skill configuration file (skill.yaml) — defines a single skill's metadata and template variables. Note: this is a build-time config file, NOT the output SKILL.md frontmatter. Fields are processed internally; only the rendered template becomes SKILL.md. Whenever skill.yaml is present, including a group file that only contributes variables, the loader requires `skillprism` with value 1 (string or integer) and rejects the legacy `harnesses` key. `name` and `description` are not required: a group skill.yaml may omit them. A leaf skill that omits `name` uses its directory name; a leaf skill that omits `description` gets an empty description.

skillprism.description: Manifest format version. Required. The loader accepts only the string "1" or the integer 1.

name.description: Skill name. Optional. A group skill.yaml may omit it. A leaf skill that omits it uses the directory name. The loader does not restrict the character set or length.

description.description: Brief description of what the skill does and when to use it. Optional. A group skill.yaml may omit it. A leaf skill that omits it gets an empty description.

version.description: Skill version string, used internally. The loader accepts any string.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file (maps to SKILL.md frontmatter)

compatibility.description: Environment requirements. Indicates intended product, system packages, network access, etc. (maps to SKILL.md frontmatter). The loader accepts any string.

required-capabilities.description: Harness capabilities this skill requires (e.g., subagent, sidecar, manifest, allowed-tools). The Harness Resolver checks these against the selected harness definition and reports MissingCapability errors for any that aren't satisfied.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata (maps to SKILL.md frontmatter). Keys are strings, values are strings.

allowed-tools.description: Pre-approved tools the skill may use. The loader accepts a string only, not a YAML list. Maps to SKILL.md frontmatter.

variables.description: Template variables available to SKILL.md (or SKILL.md.j2) during rendering. Structure is user-defined.

when_to_use.description: Additional trigger phrases or example requests (Claude Code). Appended to description in skill listing.

argument-hint.description: Autocomplete hint shown after skill name (e.g., [issue-number]) (Claude Code)

arguments.description: Named positional arguments for $name substitution in skill content (Claude Code). The loader accepts a YAML list of strings only, not a single string.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, prevents agent from automatically loading this skill (Claude Code, Factory, Pi). Use for manual-only workflows. Omission leaves the field unset; the loader does not fill a default.

user-invocable.description: When false, hides from / command menu (Claude Code, Factory). Omission leaves the field unset; the loader does not fill a default.

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from agent's available pool while this skill is active (Claude Code). The loader accepts a YAML list of strings only, not a single string.

model.description: Model override for skill execution (Claude Code). E.g., claude-sonnet-4-20250514.

effort.description: Effort level hint for skill execution (Claude Code). The loader accepts any string.

context.description: Context mode string. The loader sets context forking only when the value is "fork"; any other string is accepted and does not enable forking.

agent.description: Subagent type to use when context is set to fork (Claude Code)

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this skill (Claude Code). Values may be any YAML value.

paths.description: Glob patterns limiting automatic activation (Claude Code). The loader accepts a YAML list of strings only, not a single string.

shell.description: Shell for command injection in this skill (Claude Code). The loader accepts any string.

overrides.description: Per-harness overrides (build-time config, stripped from rendered output). Keys are harness IDs (e.g., claude, codex). The loader rejects a `harnesses` key here.

additionalProperties.description: Override variables and macros for this harness. Unknown keys are rejected.

variables.description: Harness-specific variable overrides (merged with top-level variables, harness wins)

macros.description: Harness-specific macro overrides for this skill only. Values are strings.
